description:
Cozy Fireplace Music! — Sitting cozy by the fireplace! Crackle, pop, snap! Have you ever wondered what makes burning logs pop and shoot out tiny sparks?
Kids science answer for "why does wood crackle in fire kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Wood contains trapped pockets of water, resin, and sap deep inside microscopic cellulose tubes. As heat turns trapped water to expanding steam, the high pressure ruptures the wood chamber with a loud pop!
